12. Because of the unique filming schedule of the movie X(shooting for a few days once a year), Y had to ensure she didn't get any major cosmetic surgery or drastic permanent changes to her face for over 12 years.
When she won the Academy Award for Best Supporting Actress for the movie Y in 2015, she gave one of the most talked-about speeches in recent history. Instead of just thanking agents, she used her platform to demand equal pay for women and wage equality. She later admitted that she was warned by several people in the industry that her "political" stance might hurt her career and cost her roles, but she stated she didn't care because the cause was more important than the "prestige.” Id X and Y.
